exact_action_receipts.policy_question: Whether to bar federal support for automated speed-enforcement cameras on military installations subject to security-related exceptions.

scope_bounded_teaser.text: One meaningful contrast in the reviewed record is opposition to the reviewed displacement of D.C. public-safety rules alongside support for two terrorism-preparedness mandates; separate firearm-access and fraud-enforcement patterns remain primary findings.
